programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

programme.title: The Face of Love
programme.desc: A lonely widow (Annette Bening) begins a romance with an art teacher (Ed Harris) who looks just like her late husband but does not tell him of the resemblance.

programme.title: Enemies of the State
programme.desc: An average American family becomes entangled in a bizarre web of espionage and corporate secrets when the U.S. government targets the family's hacker son.

programme.title: Disappearance at Clifton Hill
programme.desc: A troubled young woman returns to her hometown of Niagara Falls, where the memory of a long-ago kidnapping quickly ensnares her.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Infinity
programme.desc: In 1913, brilliant East Indian mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan (Dev Patel) travels to Trinity College in England to work with professor G.H. Hardy (Jeremy Irons).

programme.title: King Cobra
programme.desc: An adult film producer that discovers a new star finds himself the target of rival producer, leading to murder.

programme.title: Dating Death
programme.desc: S01 E01 Rodney Alcala flees Los Angeles in 1968 after the rape and attempted murder of an 8-year-old girl, but after moving to New York under an assumed name, he begins working at a New Hampshire arts camp for children.

programme.title: Dating Death
programme.desc: S01 E02 After his early release in 1974 from prison, Rodney Alcala's victim count continues to rise as he uses his photography skills to prey on both young women and children.

programme.title: Dating Death
programme.desc: S01 E03 In 1979 on Huntington Beach, Calif., a girl goes missing and is later found dead in a wooded area; the only lead is a sketch composite that resembles Alcala.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E02 Rebekah Heath It was a mystery that plagued law enforcement for over years: four unidentified bodies found inside barrels in the woods; one woman searching for answers from her own troubled past sets herself on a journey to give the victims back their names.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E06 Josh Hallmark A young man whose childhood was marked by tragedy learns of a relatively unknown serial killer, and finds himself thinking about unidentified victims; it isn't long before that pursuit becomes a full-time job and identifying victims an obsession.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E01 The Mays Family A young mother is found unresponsive in bed, and her cause of death is determined to be an accidental heroin overdose; but her family questions everything about the circumstances around her death, so they launch their own investigation.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E03 Deb & Judy A young man leaves home for the corner store, but dies on a rainy sidewalk just down the street; bystanders claim that he fell off of his bike, but his mom and sister don't buy it; they hit the streets to find answers.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E05 Lisa Coppel A young girl's life was thrown into chaos when her single mother died by a gunshot wound in their remote mountain home; the journey for the truth would be long and arduous, and it would be thirty years until justice was finally served.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
programme.desc: S01 E04 John Allore When a college student was found dead in rural Quebec, police refused to call it a murder; but years later, her brother continues his own investigation into her death; on the eve of a trip to return to the scene of the crime, tragedy strikes again.

programme.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
programme.desc: S01 E01 Part 1: Woman Down in Central Park The NYPD identifies a dead girl in Central Park as Jennifer Levin; the search for her killer leads to her prep school friend Robert Chambers; Robert confesses he killed Jennifer Levin accidentally during rough sex.

programme.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
programme.desc: S01 E02 Part 2: Rough Sex Robert confesses he killed Jennifer Levin accidentally during rough sex; his mother hires a high-profile attorney who says Jennifer was the aggressor.

programme.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
programme.desc: S01 E03 Part 3: Who Is Robert Chambers? Robert's preppy persona begins to crumble; when the Church steps in to support Robert, the judge releases him on bail.

programme.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
programme.desc: S01 E04 Part 4: Blame the Victim The media jumps on the defense's strategy to make Jennifer seem fast and loose; the prosecution works to establish motive.

programme.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park
programme.desc: S01 E05 Part 5: The Trial of the Decade Both sides present their cases; jurors are mesmerized by Robert's charisma; afraid Robert has charmed them, the prosecution offers a plea deal.

programme.title: The Catcher Was a Spy
programme.desc: Major League Baseball player Moe Berg lives a double life as a spy for the Office of Strategic Services during World War II.

programme.title: Freak Show
programme.desc: Billy, a cross-dressing teen, starts attending an ultra-conservative high school. He takes a stand for his individuality by running for homecoming queen.

programme.title: Framing John DeLorean
programme.desc: The extraordinary life and career of controversial automaker John DeLorean -- from his meteoric rise at General Motors Co. to his obsessive quest to build the world's best sports car.

programme.title: Before I Disappear
programme.desc: A deeply troubled young man (Shawn Christensen) and his precocious niece (Fátima Ptacek) bond during a nighttime odyssey through New York City.

programme.title: The Torch
programme.desc: Guitar icon Buddy Guy reflects on his legacy and passes along the blues lessons he received from legends Muddy Waters and Howlin' Wolf.

programme.title: Una noche
programme.desc: Raul dreams of escaping to Miami. When he is accused of assault, he convinces his friend Elio to help him cross the ocean.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E01 Revenge of the PTA Mom A wealthy Orange County mom and her husband, both attorneys, plot revenge on the PTA president for not properly supervising their son at school; it starts with a smear campaign, then escalates to police reports; eventually, she takes it too far.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E02 A Special Investigation One woman's prestigious pedigree and dedication to social justice almost garner her a top-ranking political appointment, until her actions reveal a corruption scandal that goes deeper than ever expected.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E03 Fishing for the Truth After an astounding winning streak made these Lake Erie partners the best fishermen at the year's top Walleye tournament, an unbelievable catch turns out to be just as implausible as it looks, shocking people world-wide.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E04 Affluenza A wealthy Texas teen has a deadly drunk driving accident; his lawyers claim he suffers from affluenza, and it works, no jail time; caught violating his probation, he flees to Mexico, but there is more to this story than just the headlines.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E05 Dickweed: Part 1 The twisted tale of an Orange County crime that set off an international manhunt and a Houdini-style jailbreak; and one detective will stop at nothing to get justice.

programme.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot
programme.desc: S01 E06 Dickweed: Part 2 The suspect slips through law enforcement's fingers, but the detective finds the perfect partner to help with the case, the fugitive's wife; together they'll set a trap that even this criminal can't escape, until he does.

programme.title: Kennedy, Sinatra and the Mafia
programme.desc: S01 E01 Frank Sinatra's barkeep father and midwife mother had loose affiliations with organized crime that assisted Frank in his rise to stardom; John F Kennedy's father's bootlegging past cultivated criminal connections that helped him to run for President.

programme.title: Kennedy, Sinatra and the Mafia
programme.desc: S01 E02 Kennedy wins the Presidency; Robert Kennedy, hellbent on cracking down on the Mafia, was appointed Attorney General; Hoover discovers a love triangle, he tells the President to cut all ties with the Mafia, including Sinatra.

programme.title: The Heiress and the Heist
programme.desc: S01 E01 To rebel against her privileged background and family wealth, Rose Dugdale organizes the robbery of her family home.

programme.title: The Heiress and the Heist
programme.desc: S01 E02 On the night of April 26, 1974, Dugdale leads a raid on Russborough House to steal paintings kept in the Palladian mansion; under her instructions, the gang steals 19 works of art from old masters valued at around $90 million in present times.

programme.title: The Heiress and the Heist
programme.desc: S01 E03 The paintings are recovered and Dugdale is sentenced to prison.

programme.title: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
programme.desc: S01 E01 Among the secret murders explored are Judith Roberts, Mary Judge in Leeds in 1968, a schoolgirl killed in Staffordshire in 1972 and Carol Wilkinson, a bakery worker murdered in Bradford in 1977.

programme.title: Yorkshire Ripper: The Secret Murders
programme.desc: S01 E02 The pressure continues to build on West Yorkshire Police; on top of the crimes that police decide to include in the Ripper investigation, murders and attempted murders with a clear link to the killer are discarded and left unsolved.

programme.title: Department Q: The Keeper of Lost Causes
programme.desc: Police inspector Carl Mørck and his assistant investigate a cold case involving a missing woman.

programme.title: Devil's Knot
programme.desc: The Arkansas town of West Memphis makes national headlines when three teenagers are arrested for the brutal murders of three little boys.

programme.title: Radio Bikini
programme.desc: The U.S. government removes Bikini islanders from their homes to test the atomic bomb in 1946.

programme.title: Vita & Virginia
programme.desc: A love affair develops between author Vita Sackville-West and literary icon Virginia Woolf, inspiring one of Woolf's greatest works.

programme.title: This Is GWAR
programme.desc: Filmmaker Scott Barber follows the heavy metal band GWAR, through its early days coming up through the late '80s to near-commercial success, including dark times and triumph over adversity.

programme.title: The Loneliest Planet
programme.desc: An incident on the trail tests two lovers' (Gael García Bernal, Hani Furstenberg) relationship as they take a guided hiking tour through the Caucasus Mountains.

programme.title: Department Q: The Keeper of Lost Causes
programme.desc: Police inspector Carl Mørck and his assistant investigate a cold case involving a missing woman.

programme.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster
programme.desc: S01 E01 Welcome to the Jungle When Patch O'Furr is tagged in a mysterious online post, he must face the fact that animal abusers are hiding in plain sight in the Furry Fandom; Furry Detectives comb through evidence and discover one popular YouTuber is a suspect.

programme.title: The Furry Detectives: Unmasking A Monster

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Five-year-old Saroo gets lost on a train which takes him thousands of miles across India, away from home and family. Saroo must learn to survive alone in Kolkata, before ultimately being adopted by an Australian couple. Twenty-five years later, armed with only a handful of memories, his unwavering determination, and a revolutionary technology known as Google Earth, he sets out to find his lost family and finally return to his first home. (Drama, Biography) - 2016

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: Corporate sales partners Steve Butler and Sue Thomason arrive in a small town to secure drilling rights for a natural-gas company. They believe that the economic decline has done their work for them and that the townspeople will happily accept whatever offer they make. However, they don't consider the objections of a respected schoolteacher and the leader of a grassroots campaign against the company's objective. (Drama) - 2012

programme.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
programme.desc: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney whose life gets upended when his boss and mentor -- the legendary civil rights icon William Henry Jackson -- dies unexpectedly. He's then recruited to join a law firm led by George Pierce, an ambitious lawyer who was one of Jackson's former students. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murdering a convenience store clerk. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2017

programme.desc: On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be. (Romantic comedy) - 2012

Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world. (Action, Comedy) - 2018

Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. programme.sub-title: Krory and Allen attempt to meet with Lavi and Lenalee. However, their plans are interrupted when they must investigate the mystery of a moving statue.

programme.title: Remake Our Life!
programme.desc: Kyoya Hashiba is a video game director; his company goes bankrupt, and he goes back to his family home; he wakes up ten years in the past and chooses the path he didn't originally take.
programme.sub-title: As Kyoya settles into his new reality, he discovers the challenging professional circumstances Kawasegawa is going through.
